title: Ryan Garcia demands 'actual truth' on aliens after David Grusch's explosive Joe Rogan claims go viral
byline: Global Sports Desk / TIMESOFINDIA.COM / Oct 08, 2026, 03:00 IST
excerpt: It’s time to stop pretending. We need the actual truth now.
content:
Ryan Garcia demands ‘actual truth’ on aliens after David Grusch’s explosive Joe Rogan claims go viral

Ryan Garcia has asked for the “actual truth” about aliens after former intelligence officer David Grusch made fresh claims about extraterrestrial beings on Joe Rogan’s podcast.

Grusch appeared on The Joe Rogan Experience on September 30 and discussed alleged encounters with different types of non-human beings and unusual spacecraft. Fox News host Jesse Watters later played clips from the interview on his show. Garcia reacted to the footage on Wednesday, October 7, saying he had no fear of aliens because of his faith in Jesus. He also called for the full information to be released publicly.

Ryan Garcia wants full disclosure after David Grusch interview

Garcia shared a video from Watters’ report on X and asked officials to stop withholding information about the alleged encounters.“I can care less what these creatures are here to try to do. Jesus is the conqueror of all, so I have no fear of aliens, but stop beating around the bush and release everything,” Garcia wrote.His post came days after Grusch discussed alleged alien encounters during his conversation with Joe Rogan.

Grusch described one reported type of being as very human-like. He said they had pale, bluish-white skin and compared their appearance to Greek gods.He also discussed another alleged species that he described as more than seven feet tall with a large, muscular build and scaly skin.Grusch made clear that he had not personally seen the reptilian-like beings he described. Instead, he said he had heard about them from people he considered credible.According to Grusch’s account, some of these alleged beings were involved in a violent encounter with humans. He also discussed reports of a conflict between different non-human species.Grusch said that he expects people who were directly involved in some of these alleged events to eventually speak publicly.

David Grusch also described different UFO shapes

The former intelligence officer also discussed several types of craft that he said had been reported or recovered.“So obviously there has been physical craft of all different flavors like I’ve talked about,” Grusch told Rogan. “The Tic Tacs are real. There’s eggs. There’s different types of discs. There’s boot heels... sunfish looking things. Boomerangs, crescent moon-looking craft as well.”

The claims remain allegations and have not been established as confirmed evidence of extraterrestrial life.

Grusch is not a newcomer to the UAP debate. In July 2023, he testified before a House subcommittee that he had received information from other military and intelligence personnel about an alleged secret UAP crash-retrieval and reverse-engineering program.

His written testimony said he was speaking about information provided to him rather than presenting all of it as firsthand knowledge.The 2026 Rogan interview has now brought those claims back into the spotlight. Garcia’s reaction adds another public voice calling for more information, although there is still no public confirmation that the alleged alien species or spacecraft described by Grusch exist.For now, Garcia is asking for the government to release what it knows. Grusch has also said he believes more information could eventually become public. As of October 7, Garcia had not provided further details about what specific evidence he wants released.
